description: Elections Commission - Declare that B. N. S. Perera as a member of the Negombo Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns filling a vacancy in a local government council (Negombo Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically addresses the electoral process for selecting a new council member due to a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls directly under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) as it involves electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections.
